sloka: सशेषभाग्यता ऽस्माकं यदि वीर भविष्यति ।मोहमेतौ प्रहास्येते महात्मानौ महाबलौ ।। ६.४६.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: saśeṣabhāgyatā 'smākaṁ yadi vīra bhaviṣyati ।mohametau prahāsyete mahātmānau mahābalau ।। 6.46.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! We are helpless, be confident, for those following righteousness and truthfulness there is no fear of death."
